card.name: Middle digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, such as the 0 in 1200 or the 5 in 1500. Seen mostly in dose amounts and lab counts, and sometimes in temperatures or percentages.

modes.label: Dose numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a multi-digit dose or lab threshold, before a unit like mg.

modes.label: Other statistics
modes.description: A digit inside a number in temperature or population text.
